# InOps IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

> InOps is a B2B SaaS company headquartered in Bengaluru, India, founded in 2014.
> We build Contract Labour Management Software (CLMS), Biometric Attendance Systems,
> and Salary++ — an Earned Wage Access (EWA) platform for contract workers.
> Our clients include Ashok Leyland, HAL, Foxconn, BMRCL, and other large industrial
> enterprises across 163+ manufacturing sites in India.

## Core Software

- [Contract Labour Management System (CLMS)](https://inops.tech/clms):
  End-to-end CLRA compliance platform covering contractor attendance, Form V/XIII registers,
  PF/ESI statutory deductions, minimum wage compliance, OT cost control, and biometric
  integration for Indian manufacturing enterprises.

- [Earned Wage Access / Salary++](https://inops.tech/ewa):
  EWA platform enabling contract workers to draw earned wages before payday.
  Disbursement is validated against CLMS attendance data and compliant with Indian
  labour law and RBI digital lending guidelines. Zero financial liability for employers.

- [HR Information System (HRIS)](https://inops.tech/hris):
  Workforce management for permanent and contract employees — digital onboarding,
  biometric attendance, leave management, shift scheduling, and statutory document
  tracking for Indian industrial HR teams.

- [Enterprise Solution](https://inops.tech/enterprise-solution):
  Integrated suite combining CLMS, HRIS, EWA, biometrics, and supply chain modules
  for large multi-site enterprises managing thousands of contract workers.

## Hardware & Physical Security

- [Biometric Face Recognition Terminals](https://inops.tech/face):
  Industrial-grade face recognition devices for contractor attendance and gate access
  control. Supports liveness detection and operates in high-ambient-light factory
  environments. Integrates directly with InOps CLMS.

- [Turnstiles & Flap Barriers](https://inops.tech/turnstiles):
  Factory gate access control hardware — tripod turnstiles, flap barriers, and
  full-height turnstiles integrated with InOps biometric attendance.

- [CCTV & Video Surveillance](https://inops.tech/cctv):
  IP camera systems and AI-based attendance capture for factory floor safety
  and perimeter security.

## Operations & Supply Chain

- [Delivery Management System](https://inops.tech/delivery-management):
  Last-mile and factory dispatch tracking with route management, GPS tracking,
  proof of delivery, and analytics.

- [Order Management System](https://inops.tech/order-management):
  End-to-end order lifecycle from placement to fulfillment, integrated with
  inventory and dispatch workflows.

- [Warehouse Management System](https://inops.tech/warehouse-management):
  Barcode and RFID-powered inventory tracking, storage optimisation, and stock
  movement reporting for factory warehouses.

- [Fixed Asset Management](https://inops.tech/fixed-asset-management):
  Track and audit fixed assets across sites, integrated with workforce and access controls.

- [Canteen & Visitor Management](https://inops.tech/canteen-and-visitor):
  Meal issuance, visitor desk, and subsidy controls integrated with identity and
  workforce systems.

- [Visitor Management System](https://inops.tech/visitor-management):
  Visitor pre-registration, lobby check-in, and campus access aligned with
  contractor and employee identity records.

- [Mobile Workforce App](https://inops.tech/mobile-app):
  Worker self-service for attendance, leave, payslips, and supervisor workflows
  with GPS validation.

## CLMS Modules (Deep-Dive)

- [Attendance & Leave Module](https://inops.tech/clms/modules/attendance-leave):
  Face recognition, CCTV attendance, geo-fencing, auto rostering, and leave
  management for contract workforces.

- [Wage & Payroll Module](https://inops.tech/clms/modules/wage-payroll):
  Automated minimum wage, overtime, and statutory deduction calculations with
  payroll-ready exports.

- [CLRA Compliance Software](https://inops.tech/clms/modules/compliance-report):
  Digital Form V/XIII registers, licence tracking, 9-day rule alerts, statutory returns from gate data.

- [Contractor Management Module](https://inops.tech/clms/modules/contractor-management):
  Contractor license tracking, renewals, performance signals, and multi-vendor
  governance across sites.

- [Background Verification Module](https://inops.tech/clms/modules/background-verification):
  Aadhaar-linked contractor background verification integrated with CLMS onboarding.

- [Challan Reconciliation Module](https://inops.tech/clms/modules/challan-reconciliation):
  PF/ESI challan matching against payroll deductions with gap alerts.

- [CXO Dashboard](https://inops.tech/clms/modules/cxo-dashboard):
  Executive-level visibility into workforce strength, compliance status, and cost
  metrics across all sites.

- [AI Assistance](https://inops.tech/clms/modules/ai-assistance):
  AI-driven insights, anomaly detection, and automation within the CLMS platform.

## Research & Proprietary Data

- [State of Contract Labour Compliance in Indian Manufacturing 2026](https://inops.tech/blog/state-of-contract-labour-compliance-india-2026):
  Anonymized compliance data from 163+ manufacturing sites. Covers CLRA violations,
  PF/ESI gaps, contractor onboarding failures, and what top-quartile plants do differently.

- [OT Leakage Benchmarks in Indian Factories 2026](https://inops.tech/blog/ot-leakage-benchmarks-indian-factories-2026):
  Quantifies overtime leakage (unauthorised OT, ghost OT, unclaimed legitimate OT)
  across InOps-monitored sites and documents closure patterns.

- [Biometric Attendance Accuracy Report — India 2026](https://inops.tech/blog/biometric-attendance-accuracy-report-india-2026):
  Fleet data from 300+ biometric terminals across Indian factories — accuracy rates,
  environmental failure modes, and the exception-governance gap that creates fraud risk.
